raw_text:
PLAN "Postpartum On-Ramp — Weeks 10 to 14"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary general_fitness:
    name "Rebuild baseline strength and conditioning postpartum"
  GOAL secondary mobility:
    name "Restore core and pelvic floor function"

PHASES
  PHASE "On-Ramp Block" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Reconnect — Core and Lower":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          cat_cow 1x10
          pelvic_tilt 1x10
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 1m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Walk and Upper":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          arm_circles 1x10
          scapular_retraction 1x10
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          chest_fly 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 2x8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Reconnect — Core and Lower":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          cat_cow 1x10
          hip_circles 1x10
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          split_squat 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 2x10 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 1m
          child_pose 1m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Lower and Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          cat_cow 1x10
          hip_circles 1x10
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 2x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Walk and Push-Pull":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          scapular_retraction 1x10
          arm_circles 1x10
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 2x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Full Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          cat_cow 1x10
          arm_circles 1x10
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Lower Focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          cat_cow 1x10
          hip_circles 1x10
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 1m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Cardio and Carries":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          arm_circles 1x10
        main straight_sets:
          walking 15m
          farmers_walk 3x30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          suitcase_carry 2x20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 1m
          calf_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Upper Focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          scapular_retraction 1x10
          arm_circles 1x10
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower and Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          cat_cow 1x10
          hip_circles 1x10
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Cardio and Carries":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          arm_circles 1x10
        main straight_sets:
          walking 20m
          farmers_walk 3x40 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          suitcase_carry 3x20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          cat_cow 1x10
          scapular_retraction 1x10
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 1m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m

goals.name: Rebuild baseline strength and conditioning postpartum
Restore core and pelvic floor function
